So just spent the better part of an hour fidling with device manager to get this wireless dongle working. No driver that is suggested seemed to stick, that is until I:

- Disabled driver signatures (though this could be unrelated as this driver should be signed by Microsoft themselves). - Navigated through the offical CD that came with the pack all the way to the WINDOWS XP DRIVER (specifically .inf file above the two x64 and x86 folders).

No idea as to why a drvier made for an operating system that is over a decade old is the only driver I found to work on the newest iteration of Windows, but hey it worked and if anyone else is having similar issues with 10 not picking up the drivers give this a whirl, might just work for you too.
